prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady walk along a narrow, overgrown path in Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China, under a cloudy, foggy night sky. The camera moves forward, capturing the uneven terrain covered with patches of grass and scattered rocks, flanked by dense vegetation and trees that loom large in the dim light. As the viewer progresses, the path gently curves, revealing a stone-paved area that appears weathered and moss-covered, hinting at its age and disuse. The camera angle shifts slightly upward, offering a glimpse of the vast, dark sea beyond the island's edge, shrouded in mist. The scene transitions back to the path as the viewer continues walking, passing by more dense foliage and small shrubs that encroach upon the trail. The camera then pans to the right, showing a set of stone steps leading upwards, partially obscured by shadows and undergrowth. The viewer ascends the steps, the camera tilting slightly to capture the ascent, until reaching a dilapidated building with broken windows and crumbling walls, overtaken by nature. The final moments reveal the interior of the building, with remnants of wooden beams and debris scattered across the floor, all illuminated by the faint, eerie glow of the night sky. Throughout the sequence, the lighting remains consistently low, casting deep shadows and creating an atmosphere of solitude and quiet exploration in this empty, natural outdoor setting.
